body: I have tried on Colab with TF GPU version 2.0beta1 and was able to reproduce the issue. The code snippet caused crashed in Colab after using all available RAM.
@superbobry is this related to the recent __array_interface__ changes?
I couldn't reproduce the issue using the nightly when running on CPU. Will be able to try on GPU on Monday.
I've reproduced the leak on GPU, fix is on the way.
